annual_basis: Calendar years 2020-2023 from the US product sales column of the 'Patent Expiries of Key Marketed Products' table in AstraZeneca's annual report / Form 20-F for each year.
series_start_reason: Longest gap-free run ending at the latest printed year. The US column prints a dash for 2018 and 2019 (annual reports for 2018, 2019; 20-F for 2021 prints a dash for 2019), so 2020-2023 is the gap-free run. An earlier run exists (US 159, 154, 145, 111 for 2014-2017 in the 2016 report and the 2018 report) but a US-column dash for 2015 in the 2015 report ('included in Onglyza') and the 2018-2019 dashes break continuity, so it is not spliced on.
series_end_reason: The 20-F filed 2025-02-18 (2024) has no Komboglyze/Kombiglyze XR row in the key-marketed-products table; 2023 (17) is the last year printed.
notes: US column of the row 'Komboglyze/ Kombiglyze XR' (Komboglyze is the ex-US brand; Kombiglyze XR the US one, FDA NDA 200678). The footnote on the row states 'Komboglyze / Kombiglyze XR Product Sales is included in the Onglyza Product Sales figure', so these US sales are a component of the Onglyza line, not additional to it. 2020 is 55 in the 2020 annual report (own-year) and 56 as restated in the 2021 20-F. Before February 2014 BMS printed a combined 'Onglyza/Kombiglyze' line (BMS 10-K for 2013, 877 for 2013), which is not a Kombiglyze figure.

no_quarterly_series.source_quote: Komboglyze / Kombiglyze XR Product Sales is included in the Onglyza Product Sales figure.
no_quarterly_series.details: AstraZeneca's quarterly results releases (6-K, 2014Q1-2026Q2) contain no numeric row for the brand: every occurrence is a pipeline/launch-status row or text. Only the annual Report/20-F 'Patent Expiries of Key Marketed Products' table gives US and ex-US sales per year, as shown in this series.

search_log: Listed every AstraZeneca PLC (CIK 0000901832) filing via data.sec.gov submissions (recent plus older pages; 2,052 filings, all form types).

Downloaded the main document of all 1,646 filings of form 6-K, 6-K/A, 20-F and 20-F/A that carry a primary document (2002-2026) and scanned them: HTML table rows by label, plain text for the 2002-2003 .txt releases; 2002 6-Ks before November 2002 are scanned paper documents (.paper) and were not readable.
Latest results document used: the Q2 2026 results 6-K filed 2026-07-27 (0001104659-26-086846); no later results release exists as of the search date.
Bigdata.com was available but not needed; every figure was read from the sec.gov original, never from a Bigdata.com link.
Scanned all 75 HTML results documents mentioning Xigduo, Kombiglyze or Komboglyze: no quarterly release prints a numeric Kombiglyze row; the Onglyza line includes it.

BMS (CIK 14272) 10-K for 2012 and 2013 fetched: BMS prints 'Onglyza/Kombiglyze (saxagliptin/saxagliptin and metformin)' as one line (709 for 2012, 877 for 2013), so no standalone pre-2014 figure exists.

Annual reports 2015-2020 and 20-Fs 2021-2025 checked for the row: 2015 report US '-' (included in Onglyza); 2016 report US 145/154/159; 2018 report US '-', 111, 145; 2019 report '-', '-', 111; 2020 report 55, '-', '-'; 20-Fs 2021-2023 32, 25, 17; 20-F 2024 and later no row.
2020 value taken from the 2020 report text block (first US figure of the row) and cross-checked against the 20-F for 2021 (56 restated).
